expo.description: Whether the main world is the expo: its booths built along the avenue, a tour guide for everyone who joins, and the tour's boss bar and sidebar. Turn it off on a server whose main world isn't the expo's plaza (terrain/plaza.json), and the expo stays out of the way.

greeting.description: What the greeter says to everyone who joins, before their name.

show_welcome.description: Whether a player's first join opens the welcome dialog.

tour_bossbar.description: Whether the expo shows a boss bar naming the booth a player stands in, and how much of the tour they've seen.

treasure_rolls.description: How many times /treasure rolls the treasure loot table.
